_source: GHL marketplace assets endpoint — the builder's OWN field-picker definition, read out of the `customInputConfigGenerator` → `standardFieldMappingOptions()` function shipped with the `internal_update_opportunity` / `internal_create_opportunity` action assets. Captured in ghl-internal-api-research/sniffs/02-assets.json (same source gen-catalog uses; see project memory 'assets endpoint is gen-catalog's 5th source').
_why: opp-field-shapes.json is a CORPUS artifact — it only knows fields that happened to appear in the sampled accounts, and scripts/gen-opp-shapes.mjs regenerates it from that corpus alone. Three real picker fields (lostReasonId, forecastExpectedCloseDate, forecastProbability) were absent from the corpus, so STANDARD_OPP_FIELDS was short and authoring them threw OPP_FIELD_UNKNOWN before any network call — the engine told a live account GHL could not do something it can (Grom UK, 2026-08-03, Batch 18). This file is the COMPLETE picker list, straight from the builder, and is merged with the corpus in engine/opp-shapes.mjs. Keep it in a separate file so gen-opp-shapes.mjs can regenerate the corpus artifact without dropping these.
_merge: Asymmetric, matching the catalog's own rule: the corpus NEVER loses to the rulebook. Where a field exists in both, the corpus entry keeps its observed `allowed` set and its support-tiered throw/warn behaviour; the rulebook only supplies the field's EXISTENCE and the default shape. Where a field exists only here, the rulebook value is the single allowed value (it is the builder's own definition, not an observation) and a mismatch throws.
_agreement: All 6 fields present in both agree exactly on valueFieldType and dataType (checked 2026-08-03) — the rulebook contradicts the corpus nowhere.
_shape_derivation: In the generator, a field's `fieldType` is assigned straight onto the value input (`customInputField.fieldType = currentField.fieldType`) and its `dataType` straight onto the saved attributes (`attributes['dataType'] = currentField.dataType`). So picker fieldType === the emitted `valueFieldType` and picker dataType === the emitted `dataType`. Validated against a live-harvested lostReasonId blob (Grom UK, 2026-08-03): generator says fieldType 'select' / dataType 'SINGLE_OPTIONS', the harvested step carries valueFieldType 'select' / dataType 'SINGLE_OPTIONS'.

pipelineId.label: Pipeline
pipelineId.note: Update-only in the picker. create_opportunity takes pipelineId as a TOP-LEVEL attribute, not a __customInputFields__ entry — that asymmetry is deliberate and already implemented.

pipelineStageId.label: Pipeline Stage
pipelineStageId.requiresNote: Enforced by OPP_STAGE_NO_PIPELINE. In the picker: handlePipelineStageField() disables the option until pipelineId is chosen, and checkForPipelineIdField() DELETES a stage entry that has no pipeline alongside it.

lostReasonId.label: Lost Reason
lostReasonId.requiresNote: HARD prerequisite, enforced by OPP_LOST_REASON_NO_LOST_STATUS. Two independent mechanisms in the builder's own generator: handleStatusField() disables the Lost Reason option unless a status entry exists with value 'lost' (description: "Set the status to 'Lost' to enable selecting a reason"), and checkForDependantOptions() SPLICES an existing lostReasonId entry out of __customInputFields__ whenever status is absent or not 'lost'. Identical code in BOTH the update and the create asset. So a step carrying lostReasonId without status:lost is not merely ignored at runtime — the builder deletes it on open. Live-confirmed in the UI on Grom UK 2026-08-03 (the picker only appears once Status is Lost).
lostReasonId.valueNote: The value is a lost-reason ID, not a label. The picker sources its options from GET {marketPlaceBackendURL}/opportunities/lost-reason.

forecastExpectedCloseDate.label: Expected Close Date
forecastExpectedCloseDate.valueNote: NOT live-harvested. The picker renders a date input and post-processes the value with moment(value).format() (ISO 8601 with offset); its own helper text says "Recommended formats: DD-MMM-YYYY (e.g., 11-Mar-2026), YYYY-MM-DD" on update and "MM-DD-YYYY, DD-MMM-YYYY" on create. The compiler passes the authored value through untouched rather than guessing a normalisation — harvest a live step before adding one.

forecastProbability.label: Forecast Probability
forecastProbability.valueNote: NOT live-harvested. Numeric like monetaryValue, so it goes through the same number coercion.
